description: 13 standard edit_type tags for sentence-level academic language polishing change logs.

grammar.zh_desc: 主谓一致、时态语态、冠词介词、单复数、句子完整性与基本语法错误修正。
grammar.en_desc: Subject-verb agreement, tense/voice, articles, prepositions, number, and sentence-boundary grammar fixes.

syntax.zh_desc: 悬垂修饰、长难句切分、从句嵌套梳理及语序调整，不改变命题与限定强度。
syntax.en_desc: Dangling modifiers, long-sentence splitting, clause ordering, and structural clarity without altering claims.

collocation.zh_desc: 动宾、介宾、形容词-名词等学术惯用搭配修正（如 do an experiment -> conduct an experiment）。
collocation.en_desc: Academic verb-noun, preposition, and modifier collocation fixes.

academic_register.zh_desc: 消除口语化、宣传化、绝对化表达及缩略形式，贴合目标期刊/学位/基金文体语域。
academic_register.en_desc: Removing colloquialisms, hype, contractions, and overclaiming to match target academic register.

conciseness.zh_desc: 删去空洞套话与冗余名词化（如 due to the fact that、进行了……的研究），提高信息密度。
conciseness.en_desc: Trimming wordy filler and redundant nominalizations while preserving all substantive content.

cohesion.zh_desc: 修正逻辑连接词误用与指代不明，增强句间与段落内部信息流连贯性。
cohesion.en_desc: Fixing misused transitions, unclear anaphora, and inter-sentential information flow.

terminology.zh_desc: 依据锁定术语表或领域惯例统一全篇核心术语译法、大小写与连字符变体。
terminology.en_desc: Enforcing locked glossary targets, domain conventions, capitalization, and hyphenation consistency.

abbreviation.zh_desc: 规范 Abstract 与正文中首次出现定义形式 Full Term (ABBR)，消除未定义使用与重复定义。
abbreviation.en_desc: Enforcing first-mention Full Term (ABBR) definition in Abstract and Body and removing redundant expansions.

punctuation_format.zh_desc: 全半角标点混用、引号/括号配对、英美拼写统一及图表编号样式规范。
punctuation_format.en_desc: Full/half-width punctuation alignment, US/UK spelling harmonization, and Fig./Table reference formatting.

chinglish_fix.zh_desc: 消除直译腔、主语残缺、Because...so/Although...but 迁移错误并重排英文信息重心。
chinglish_fix.en_desc: Fixing L1 transfer errors, literal translationese, and awkward topic-comment information structure.

bilingual_alignment.zh_desc: 在双语润色模式下对齐中英文句界、术语映射与限定词对应关系。
bilingual_alignment.en_desc: Aligning bilingual sentence boundaries, terminology pairs, and epistemic qualifiers.

minimal_preserve.zh_desc: 原句语法、术语、语域与限定表达均已符合标准，保持原样不作无谓改写。
minimal_preserve.en_desc: Source sentence is already accurate and idiomatic; preserved verbatim without unnecessary edits.

needs_human_review.zh_desc: 涉及术语冲突、缺失数据/占位符、语义歧义或潜在事实/公式异常，禁止擅自臆改并上浮人工确认。
needs_human_review.en_desc: Ambiguous intent, glossary conflict, missing data placeholder, or unreadable span flagged for human review.
